Ad TikTok Link Lookup — How to use
What this is
Correct mapping from TikTok ad_id → Wayfair creative_id → unique TikTok video URL.
Built to replace the broken TT Link (column F) formulas in the Performance Tracker.
Coverage (Evergreen VSA Broad Web, last 14 days)
274 ads | 272 with TikTok links | 100 unique videos
How to wire into Performance Tracker
1. Open TikTok Performance Tracker
2. Add a new tab named exactly: Ad TikTok Link Lookup
3. In A1 of that new tab, paste:
=IMPORTRANGE("SPREADSHEET_URL_PLACEHOLDER", "Lookup!A:L")
4. Click Allow access when prompted
5. On Evergreen VSA Web Broad - Ads (CLS Break Down), put TikTok ad_id in column C for each ad row
6. In column F (TT Link), use:
=IFERROR(XLOOKUP(C5,'Ad TikTok Link Lookup'!$A:$A,'Ad TikTok Link Lookup'!$J:$J,""),"")
(adjust row number; drag down)
Join keys
A ad_id = TikTok ad ID (same as Smart+ / UI Data ad id)
B creative_id = Wayfair Creative Asset ID from landing page URL
J tiktok_link = public TikTok video URL (unique per creative_id)
Do NOT lookup by ad group name — that caused the same-video bug.
